name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Okafor goes with exactly two of Navigator, Drift, and Geode.
Okafor goes with exactly one of Pilot, Fungus, or Regolith.
Either Navigator goes with Algae or Botanist goes with Eklund if and only if Echo goes with Okafor.
Cho, Geode, and Regolith go with Botanist, Navigator, and Echo, in some order.
Between Fungus and Geode, one goes with Eklund and the other with Forge.
Either Okafor goes with Forge or Geologist goes with Cho.
